edits.question: Under Section 2.12(b) of the EQT term loan Credit Agreement, if the Maturity Date is not a Business Day, when is the payment due, and what happens if the next Business Day is in another calendar month?
edits.reference_answer: The payment is made on the next following Business Day, and the extra time is reflected in computing interest or fees. But if that next Business Day falls in another calendar month, the payment is due on the immediately preceding Business Day instead. (The general next-Business-Day rule in 2.12(b)(i) expressly does not apply to Maturity Date payments; (b)(ii) governs them.)
